charts.title: EPIC 206215704 b: orbits around EPIC 206215704
charts.description: The orbits of EPIC 206215704's planets in this map from above, to scale, with EPIC 206215704 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.
